title: lespedeza thunbergii var. albiflora
intro: Lespedeza thunbergii var. albiflora, commonly known as White Lespedeza, is a flowering plant in the legume family that is native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of White Lespedeza include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of White Lespedeza include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
